 37 | // A URLLoaderThrottle gets notified at various points during the process of
 38 | // loading a resource. At each stage, it has the opportunity to defer the
 39 | // resource load.
 40 | //
 41 | // Note that while a single throttle deferring a load at any given step will
 42 | // block the load from progressing further until a subsequent Delegate::Resume()
 43 | // call is made, it does NOT prevent subsequent throttles from processing the
 44 | // same step of the request if multiple throttles are affecting the load.
 45 | class BLINK_COMMON_EXPORT URLLoaderThrottle {
 46 |  public:
 47 |   // An interface for the throttle implementation to resume (when deferred) or
 48 |   // cancel the resource load. Please note that these methods could be called
 49 |   // in-band (i.e., inside URLLoaderThrottle notification methods such as
 50 |   // WillStartRequest), or out-of-band.
 51 |   //
 52 |   // It is guaranteed that throttles calling these methods won't be destroyed
 53 |   // synchronously.
 54 |   class BLINK_COMMON_EXPORT Delegate {
 55 |    public:
 56 |     // Cancels the resource load with the specified error code and an optional,
 57 |     // application-defined reason description.
 58 |     virtual void CancelWithError(int error_code,
 59 |                                  std::string_view custom_reason = "") = 0;
 60 | 
 61 |     // Cancels the resource load with the specified error code and an optional,
 62 |     // application-defined reason description with optional extended_reason().
 63 |     virtual void CancelWithExtendedError(int error_code,
 64 |                                          int extended_reason_code,
 65 |                                          std::string_view custom_reason = "") {}
 66 | 
 67 |     // Resumes the deferred resource load. It is a no-op if the resource load is
 68 |     // not deferred or has already been canceled.
 69 |     virtual void Resume() = 0;
 70 | 
 71 |     // Updates the response head which is deferred to be sent. This method needs
 72 |     // to be called when the response is deferred on
 73 |     // URLLoaderThrottle::WillProcessResponse() and before calling
 74 |     // Delegate::Resume().
 75 |     virtual void UpdateDeferredResponseHead(
 76 |         network::mojom::URLResponseHeadPtr new_response_head,
 77 |         mojo::ScopedDataPipeConsumerHandle body);
 78 | 
 79 |     // Replaces the URLLoader and URLLoaderClient endpoints held by the
 80 |     // ThrottlingURLLoader instance.
 81 |     virtual void InterceptResponse(
 82 |         mojo::PendingRemote<network::mojom::URLLoader> new_loader,
 83 |         mojo::PendingReceiver<network::mojom::URLLoaderClient>
 84 |             new_client_receiver,
 85 |         mojo::PendingRemote<network::mojom::URLLoader>* original_loader,
 86 |         mojo::PendingReceiver<network::mojom::URLLoaderClient>*
 87 |             original_client_receiver,
 88 |         mojo::ScopedDataPipeConsumerHandle* body);
 89 | 
 90 |     // Indicates a restart did occur due to a Critical-CH HTTP Header.
 91 |     virtual void DidRestartForCriticalClientHint() {}
 92 | 
 93 |    protected:
 94 |     virtual ~Delegate();
 95 |   };

100 |   // a different sequence. If this method is called it must be before any of the
101 |   // Will* methods below and may only be called once.

104 |   // Called exactly once before the resource request is started.
105 |   //
106 |   // |request| needs to be modified before the callback returns (i.e.
107 |   // asynchronously touching the pointer in defer case is not valid)
108 |   // When |request->url| is modified it will make an internal redirect, which
109 |   // might have some side-effects: drop upload streams data might be dropped,
110 |   // redirect count may be reached.
111 |   //
112 |   // Implementations should be aware that throttling can happen multiple times
113 |   // for the same |request|, even after one instance of the same throttle
114 |   // subclass already modified the request. This happens, e.g., when a service
115 |   // worker initially elects to handle a request but then later falls back to
116 |   // network, so new throttles are created for another URLLoaderFactory to
117 |   // handle the request.
118 |   virtual void WillStartRequest(network::ResourceRequest* request, bool* defer);
119 | 
120 |   // If non-null is returned a histogram will be logged using this name when the
121 |   // throttle defers the navigation in WillStartRequest().
122 |   virtual const char* NameForLoggingWillStartRequest();

124 |   // Called when the request was redirected.  |redirect_info| contains the
125 |   // redirect responses's HTTP status code and some information about the new
126 |   // request that will be sent if the redirect is followed, including the new
127 |   // URL and new method.
128 |   //
129 |   // Request headers added to |to_be_removed_request_headers| will be removed
130 |   // before the redirect is followed. Headers added to
131 |   // |modified_request_headers| and |modified_cors_exempt_request_headers| will
132 |   // be merged into the existing request headers and cors_exempt_headers before
133 |   // the redirect is followed.
134 |   //
135 |   // If |redirect_info->new_url| is modified by a throttle, the request will be
136 |   // redirected to the new URL. Only one throttle can update this and it must
137 |   // have the same origin as |redirect_info->new_url|. See the comments for
138 |   // WillStartRequest on possible side-effects.
139 |   virtual void WillRedirectRequest(
140 |       net::RedirectInfo* redirect_info,
141 |       const network::mojom::URLResponseHead& response_head,
142 |       bool* defer,
143 |       network::HttpRequestHeadersUpdateParams* headers_update_params);
144 | 
145 |   // Called when the response headers and meta data are available.
146 |   virtual void WillProcessResponse(
147 |       const GURL& response_url,
148 |       network::mojom::URLResponseHead* response_head,
149 |       bool* defer);
150 | 
151 |   // If non-null is returned a histogram will be logged using this name when the
152 |   // throttle defers the navigation in WillProcessResponse().
153 |   virtual const char* NameForLoggingWillProcessResponse();
154 | 
155 |   // When `*restart_with_url_reset` is set to true in
156 |   // `BeforeWillProcessResponse` or `BeforeWillRedirectRequest`, the caller
157 |   // should restart the URL loader using the original URL before modified by
158 |   // WillStartRequest(). When a URL loader is restarted, throttles will NOT have
159 |   // their WillStartRequest() method called again - that is only called for the
160 |   // initial request start.
161 |   using RestartWithURLReset =
162 |       base::StrongAlias<struct RestartWithURLResetTag, bool>;
163 | 
164 |   // Called prior WillProcessResponse() to allow throttles to restart the URL
165 |   // load by setting `RestartWithURLReset` to true.
166 |   //
167 |   // Having this method separate from WillProcessResponse() ensures that
168 |   // WillProcessResponse() is called at most once even in the presence of
169 |   // restarts.
170 |   virtual void BeforeWillProcessResponse(
171 |       const GURL& response_url,
172 |       const network::mojom::URLResponseHead& response_head,
173 |       RestartWithURLReset* restart_with_url_reset);
174 | 
175 |   // Called prior WillRedirectRequest() to allow throttles to restart the URL
176 |   // load by setting `RestartWithURLReset` to true.
177 |   //
178 |   // Having this method separate from WillRedirectRequest() ensures that
179 |   // WillRedirectRequest() is called at most once per redirect even in the
180 |   // presence of restarts.
181 |   //

183 |   // will cause this to be run again. Ensure that this doesn't cause loops.
184 |   virtual void BeforeWillRedirectRequest(
185 |       const net::RedirectInfo& redirect_info,
186 |       const network::mojom::URLResponseHead& response_head,
187 |       RestartWithURLReset* restart_with_url_reset);
188 | 
189 |   // Called if there is a non-OK net::Error in the completion status.
190 |   virtual void WillOnCompleteWithError(
191 |       const network::URLLoaderCompletionStatus& status);
192 | 
193 |   void set_delegate(Delegate* delegate) { delegate_ = delegate; }
194 | 
195 |  protected:
196 |   URLLoaderThrottle();
197 | 
198 |   raw_ptr<Delegate> delegate_ = nullptr;
199 | };
